data.comment: Implementation: added centralised feedback(kind, details) in controller.js (start/stop/sending/empty) + injected playSound; config feedbackSound via PI_VOICE_INPUT_FEEDBACK_SOUND (default true, boolean coercion + warning fallback); wired terminal bell in index.ts. Tests added to test-voice-controller.mjs and test-voice-config.mjs; docs updated in README.md and docs/dev/voice-input.md. Full-suite gate first attempt timed out at 2700s under heavy host load (multiple concurrent repo suites); re-running full suite with an extended timeout to populate the test cache.
